cues.title: QuickStart 1 · Illumina
cues.text: Open browser setup after downloading and verifying the reads. This recording uses synthetic file listings and checks.

cues.title: QuickStart 1 · Illumina · preservation
cues.text: Choose preservation from specimen records. Fresh is selected only as demonstration metadata here.

cues.title: QuickStart 1 · Illumina · discover inputs
cues.text: Review the prefilled FASTQ folder, then choose Discover samples. Each Illumina read pair stays together.

cues.title: QuickStart 1 · Illumina · sample groups
cues.text: Assign the example sample to Cancer. Use the type dropdown; you can also drag cards between groups.

cues.title: QuickStart 1 · Illumina · CNA settings
cues.text: Keep Copy-number analysis and set a CPU budget. This Illumina example uses QDNAseq with 100 kb bins.

cues.title: QuickStart 1 · Illumina · tools and reference
cues.text: Choose the backend you installed. Keep prepared hg38 download; real downloads begin only when you start analysis.

cues.title: QuickStart 1 · Illumina · separate project
cues.text: Confirm a distinct project folder. Keep optional short-variant analysis off for this CNA QuickStart.

cues.title: QuickStart 1 · Illumina · save and review
cues.text: Save configuration and check. Resolve any errors before Run analysis. These displayed checks are simulated.

cues.title: QuickStart 1 · Illumina · ready for your run
cues.text: In a real project, choose Run analysis after checks pass and keep its terminal open. This demo stops here; no analysis was run.

cues.title: QuickStart 1 · Oxford Nanopore
cues.text: Open browser setup after downloading and verifying the reads. This recording uses synthetic file listings and checks.

cues.title: QuickStart 1 · Oxford Nanopore · preservation
cues.text: Choose preservation from specimen records. Fresh is selected only as demonstration metadata here.

cues.title: QuickStart 1 · Oxford Nanopore · discover inputs
cues.text: Choose fastq_pass. Each barcode stays one sample, even when it contains several FASTQ batches.

cues.title: QuickStart 1 · Oxford Nanopore · sample groups
cues.text: Assign the example sample to Cancer. Use the type dropdown; you can also drag cards between groups.

cues.title: QuickStart 1 · Oxford Nanopore · sample name
cues.text: Rename barcode01 to DRR165691. The barcode still identifies the same FASTQ input.

cues.title: QuickStart 1 · Oxford Nanopore · CNA settings
cues.text: Keep Copy-number analysis, ichorCNA and 500 kb bins. FASTQs alone do not provide methylation calls.

cues.title: QuickStart 1 · Oxford Nanopore · tools and reference
cues.text: Choose the backend you installed. Keep prepared hg38 download; real downloads begin only when you start analysis.

cues.title: QuickStart 1 · Oxford Nanopore · separate project
cues.text: Confirm a distinct project folder. Keep optional short-variant analysis off for this CNA QuickStart.

cues.title: QuickStart 1 · Oxford Nanopore · save and review
cues.text: Save configuration and check. Resolve any errors before Run analysis. These displayed checks are simulated.

cues.title: QuickStart 1 · Oxford Nanopore · ready for your run
cues.text: In a real project, choose Run analysis after checks pass and keep its terminal open. This demo stops here; no analysis was run.

# ILLUSTRATIVE NATIVE CONFIGURATION — browser simulation only.
# Uses the real setup field names; no files have been written or validated.
# The paths, reads and resources are fictional and this is not a runnable project.
# Reference choice: download prepared indexes at run time (not performed here).
mode: "illumina"
lpwgs_root: "/demo/oncotracer-quickstart1/illumina/reference"
hg38_auto_download: true
reference_download_cache: "/demo/oncotracer-quickstart1/.oncotracer-reference-downloads"
outdir: "/demo/oncotracer-quickstart1/illumina/results"
threads: 4
force: false
run_cna_classifier: false
knowledge_web: false
illumina_samplesheet: "/demo/oncotracer-quickstart1/illumina/config/samplesheet.csv"
illumina_caller: "qdnaseq"
illumina_binsize_kb: 100
run_variants: false
variant_specimen_type: "fresh"
execution_backend: "conda"
sample_metadata: "/demo/oncotracer-quickstart1/illumina/config/sample_metadata.csv"

# Illustrative companion config/samplesheet.csv (not written):
# sample,fastq_1,fastq_2,status
# "ERR12341627","/demo/oncotracer-quickstart1/input/illumina/ERR12341627_1.fastq.gz","/demo/oncotracer-quickstart1/input/illumina/ERR12341627_2.fastq.gz","tumor"
